author: Insanely_Dope_
body: Im Insanely_Dope_ and 4 minutes ago I was just playing nebula and I thought I would be killed by someone because I was knocked into the void, but i got hit under the map and started glitching and it said: you may not enter this area of the map.  A i said in chat help Im stuck under the map.  Then a moderator Dinlas Banned me for flying.  Please fix this mistake.

title: Banned for no reason

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

Due to an issue with some of the map boundaries your infraction has been appealed. This moderator was probably not aware of the glitch and mistakenly assumed you were flying. Sorry for the inconvenience!
